dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's all from me, Nam. Do you have any questions for us?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈɔːl frəm miː, ˈnɑːm. duː juː ˈhæv ˈɛni ˈkwɛstʃənz fər ʌs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I do. Could you tell me what the job involves?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈduː. kʊd juː ˈtɛl miː ˈwʌt ðə ˈdʒɑːb ɪnˈvɑːlvz?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Of course. Trainees spend three months in each department. They help with different projects.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. ˌtreɪˈniːz ˈspɛnd ˈθriː ˈmʌnθs ɪn ˈiːtʃ dɪˈpɑːrtmənt. ðeɪ ˈhɛlp wɪð ˈdɪfərənt ˈprɑːdʒɛkts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I see. I'd like to know whether trainees have their own duties.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsiː. aɪd ˈlaɪk tə ˈnoʊ ˈwɛðər ˌtreɪˈniːz ˈhæv ðɛr ˈoʊn ˈduːtiz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes. Each trainee has a few responsibilities, for example, writing reports for the team.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈiːtʃ ˌtreɪˈniː ˈhæz ə ˈfjuː rɪˌspɑːnsəˈbɪlətiz, fər ɪɡˈzæmpəl, ˈraɪtɪŋ rɪˈpɔːrts fər ðə ˈtiːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Could you tell me what the working hours are?
dialogue.reading: kʊd juː ˈtɛl miː ˈwʌt ðə ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ˌaʊərz ˈɑːr?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nine to six, Monday to Friday. Sometimes trainees have to work late, but not often.
dialogue.reading: ˈnaɪn tə ˈsɪks, ˈmʌndeɪ tə ˈfraɪdeɪ. ˈsʌmtaɪmz ˌtreɪˈniːz ˈhæf tə ˈwɜːrk ˈleɪt, bʌt ˈnɑːt ˈɔːfən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's fine. And do you know when you'll make your decision?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈfaɪn. ənd duː juː ˈnoʊ wɛn juːl ˈmeɪk jʊr dɪˈsɪʒən?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: We'll let you know by the end of next week.
dialogue.reading: wiːl ˈlɛt juː ˈnoʊ baɪ ði ˈɛnd əv ˈnɛkst ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you, Ms. Harris. I'd really like to join your team.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː, ˈmɪz ˈhærɪs. aɪd ˈriːli ˈlaɪk tə ˈdʒɔɪn jʊr ˈtiːm.
